skills: Up to 4 Fire hits forward. The 3rd and 4th hits count as Combustion Attacks.
With enough Pyre, hold Basic Attack to unleash Fire DMG. Its finishing move triggers 1 Abloom on enemies with an Attribute Anomaly. Invulnerable while using it.
If Special Attack: Fire Sweep doesn't land a Perfect Block, press Basic Attack to follow up.

core.name: Nirvana
core.text:
Attribute Anomalies applied by any squad member can CRIT, and Anomaly Mastery makes those crits stronger.
Once per fight, fatal damage doesn't take her down: switching back to Phoenix restores 50% of her Max HP.
Combustion Attacks build up Pyre (up to 120), which powers her enhanced Basic Attack: Purifying Flame, an Abloom trigger.
Using an EX Special Attack puts her in her Wither and Bloom / Wax and Wane state for 20s.
Core Skill A–F: Anomaly Mastery +12 at A, C and E, and Base ATK +25 at B, D and F.

mindscapes: Starts each fight with 1 Ascension point (once every 180s in Investigation Zones). Anomaly DMG against enemies in Sear gets +25% CRIT DMG. Combustion Attacks build Pyre 15% faster.
Burn she applies lasts 2s longer. +30% DMG against enemies in Sear.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
When the Soul-Searching Blaze finishing move or Basic Attack: Purifying Flame hits an enemy with an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers 1 extra Abloom at a fixed 600% multiplier.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
Ignores 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES. EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare grants 1 Ascension point. Her Abloom ignores 40% of enemy DEF.
source: From her 3.3 release, summarised. Her other skills are added as their details come in.
